Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and >100,000 CFU/mL Klebsiella pneumoniae, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and proteinuria is noted. Low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy based on sensitivity testing.
